commands.name: slim-argv-role-matrix
commands.run:
env -u HERDR_ENV -u HERDR_PANE_ID -u HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID -u HERDR_TAB_ID -u HERDR_SOCKET_PATH -u HERDR_BIN_PATH -u HERDR_ACCOUNT_ID -u HERDR_PERSONAL -u WORKFLOW_PERSONAL_ACCOUNT -u CLAUDE_PERSONAL_ONLY -u CLAUDE_WORK_TREE -u CLAUDE_WORK_CONFIG_DIR -u CODEX_HOME -u XDG_STATE_HOME -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT -u CLAUDE_PID -u CLAUDE_EFFORT -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
def argv(runtime, role, mode):
    extra = ["--config-json", '{"mechanical":{"designated":true,"review_gate":true}}'] if role == "mechanical" else []
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "claude/hooks/agent_runtime.py", "launch-plan", "--runtime", runtime,
                        "--role", role, "--provisional", "--cwd", ".", "--sandbox", "read-only", "--mode", mode] + extra,
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (runtime, role, mode, p.stdout, p.stderr)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)["argv"]
slim = ["mechanical", "read_only", "reviewer", "development_reviewer", "skeptic", "plan_reviewer"]
full = ["controller", "planner", "implementation", "think"]
for mode in ("interactive", "headless"):
    for role in slim:
        a = argv("claude", role, mode)
        assert a.count("--strict-mcp-config") == 1, (role, mode, a)
        assert a.index("--strict-mcp-config") == a.index("--permission-mode") + 2, (role, mode, a)
    for role in full:
        a = argv("claude", role, mode)
        assert "--strict-mcp-config" not in a, (role, mode, a)
    a = argv("codex", "reviewer", mode)
    assert "--strict-mcp-config" not in a, (mode, a)
print("ok slim argv matrix")
PY

commands.name: probe-skill-static
commands.run:
S=claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/SKILL.md
grep -q -F -- "PROBE_JSON=\"\$(claude --model fable --safe-mode --max-turns 1 -p 'Reply with the single word: ok' --output-format json </dev/null)\"" "$S" \
&& ! grep -q -F 'claude --model fable -p' "$S" \
&& ! grep -q -E 'PROBE_JSON=.*(mktemp|cd )' "$S" \
&& ! grep -q -F 'If `CLS` is not `available`' "$S" \
&& grep -q -F 'diagnostic sample for every probe, whatever `CLS` is' "$S" \
&& ind=$(grep -n -F -- '- `indeterminate` (no `claude`' "$S" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1) \
&& app=$(grep -n -F -- '- After the map is written or the launches are aborted, append a' "$S" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1) \
&& [ -n "$ind" ] && [ -n "$app" ] && [ "$app" -gt "$ind" ] \
&& grep -q -F 'best-effort append after every section-1 probe' claude/skills/herdr-orchestration/references/state-layout.md

commands.name: claude-md-trimmed-with-guardrails
commands.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("CLAUDE.md"); text = p.read_text(); lines = text.splitlines()
assert len(lines) <= 70, len(lines)
assert len(text.encode()) <= 4000, len(text.encode())
assert "## Architecture" in lines
assert ".claude/skills/dotfiles-architecture-contract/references/install-layout.md" in text
for g in (
    "- `settings.json` is seeded and reconciled from `claude/settings.json.tmpl`, never symlinked.",
    "- `claude/agents/` is whitelist-tracked; installers must not write into it.",
    "- Personal Claude launches keep `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` unset; never hardcode an account-to-directory map.",
    "- Never run `herdr integration install claude` (or `codex`) on a dotfiles-managed machine.",
    "- Never commit credentials or copy a token into a tracked file.",
):
    assert g in lines, g
for gone in ("**Symlink targets:**", "**Codex plugin integration:**", "**Herdr (agent terminal multiplexer):**"):
    assert gone not in text, gone
print("ok CLAUDE.md trimmed", len(lines), len(text.encode()))
PY

commands.name: install-layout-verbatim
commands.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base = subprocess.run(["git", "show", "906b302:CLAUDE.md"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines()
moved = [l for l in base[39:94] if l.strip()]
assert moved[0].startswith("**Install flow:**") and moved[-1].startswith("idempotent install step)"), (moved[0], moved[-1])
ref = Path(".claude/skills/dotfiles-architecture-contract/references/install-layout.md").read_text().splitlines()
missing = [l for l in moved if l not in ref]
assert not missing, missing[:3]
assert ref[0] == "# Install layout, symlink targets, and hook catalogue", ref[0]
print("ok", len(moved), "moved lines present verbatim")
PY

commands.name: scope-unchanged-elsewhere
commands.run:
git diff --quiet 906b302 -- claude/hooks/herdr_dispatch.py claude/hooks/herdr_dispatch_cli.py claude/settings.json.tmpl install \
&& ! git ls-files | grep -q 'settings.worker.json' \
&& python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
d = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "-U0", "906b302", "--", "claude/hooks/herdr_orch_core.py"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
minus = [l for l in d.splitlines() if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---")]
plus = [l for l in d.splitlines() if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++")]
assert len(minus) == 1 and len(plus) == 1, (minus, plus)
assert plus[0].replace('"--strict-mcp-config", ', "", 1)[1:] == minus[0][1:], (minus, plus)
print("ok core diff is the run-mech argv line only")
PY
